General Chiang Kai-shek

General Chiang Kai-shek ( 蔣介石 ) alias
Chiang Chung-tseng ( 蔣中正 ) was born in September
in the 15th year of the Emperor Kwan; Shu (1888) at Chi
Kow Village ( 溪口鎮 ), Jing Shao Shang ( 禽孝鄉 ),
Fenghwa Hsien, Chekiang. His original name is Chiang
Zai-tah ( 蔣瑞泰 ). Little is known of his parents
except that he was brought up by his mother, his father
having died when he was two years old. In 1901 (age of
15) he took u military science in the Feng Loh ( 奉麓 )
School and continued his studies in the Paoting Military
College, Paoting, Chihli (Hopei) Province but did not
graduate from that college. One of his intimate friends
while studying at Paoting was General Chang Chun ( 張 ),
(present Mayor of Shanghai), with whom he propagated
revolutionary ideas among the students. The director
of the Paoting Military College at that time was Tuan
Chi-jui ( 段琪瑞 ), ex-Chief Executive of the Peking
Government. In 1907 (age of 21) he continued the
artillery course at the Shimbu Military Training School
in Japan together with his friend Chang Chun. Whilst
in Japan Chiang was admitted as a member of the Tung Men
Hui (former name of Kuomintang) at the recommendation of
the late Chen Chi-mei, ex-Tutuh of Shanghai, who was then
studying in the Tokio Police School. General Chiang
was introduced to Dr. Sun Yat-sen in Japan when the
latter arrived there from the U.S.A. In 1911 (age of 25)
he joined as a learner the 19th Artillery Regiment of the
3rd Division of the Imperial Japanese Army at Takada,
Japan. During the revolution in 1911 he was a sub-
ordinate of Chen Chi-mei and took part in the attack on

蒋介石将军

蒋介石将军（蔣介石），别名
蒋中正（蔣中正），生于清光绪
十五年（1888年）九月，籍贯浙江
奉化县禽孝鄉（原文为 Jing Shao Shang，疑为笔误或特定旧称，此处依上下文及常见地名对应为奉化溪口一带）溪口鎮。其原名为蒋
瑞泰（蔣瑞泰）。关于其父母所知甚少，
仅知其由母亲抚养长大，父亲在其
两岁时去世。1901年（15岁）时，他进入
奉麓（Feng Loh，音译）学校学习军事科学，并继续在直隶（河北）省保定的保定陆军军官学校
深造，但未从该校毕业。他在保定求学
期间的密友之一是张群将军（張，
时任上海市市长），他曾与张群在学生中
宣传革命思想。当时保定陆军军官学校的
校长是段祺瑞（段琪瑞），即前北京政府
执政。1907年（21岁），他与好友张群一同
在日本振武学堂（Shimbu Military Training School）继续修习炮兵课程。在
日本期间，经当时正在东京警察学校
就读的前上海都督陈其美（Chen Chi-mei，即陈英士）推荐，蒋介石加入
了同盟会（国民党前身）。孙中山博士
从美国抵达日本时，蒋介石在日本
被引荐给孙博士。1911年（25岁），他以
学员身份加入位于日本高田的日本帝国
陆军第三师团第十九炮兵联队。在1911年
革命期间，他是陈其美的下属，并参与了进攻

General Chiang Kai-shek (2)

Chekiang Viceroy's Yamen at Hangchow. Soon after its
occupation, Chiang was nominated Commander of the Chekiang
forces but he declined to accept this post. In the same
year he was appointed Commander of the 87th Infantry
Regiment of the 23rd Division of the Chinese Army. He
resigned soon in favour of Chang Chun and proceeded to
Japan to learn German in preparation to the study of
military science in Germany. The intrigues of Yuan Shih-
kai (袁世凱) and in particular the assassination of
Sung Chiao-jen (宋教仁), a prominent member of the
Revolutionary Party brought him back again to China. After
organizing under Chen Chi-mei an anti-Yuan Army he
personally led an attack against the Shanghai Arsenal
(1913), but eventually his troops were defeated and Chiang
was forced to return to Japan. In 1914 Chiang assisted
the late Dr. Sun in reorganizing the Tung Meng Hui which
was hereafter known as the Chung Hwa Revolutionary Party.
Subsequently he was appointed Councillor to Dr. Sun Yat-sen
who was then President of Kwangtung. While in this
capacity he suggested to Dr. Sun to execute General Chen
Chuin-ming (陳炯明), Commander-in-Chief of Kwangtung
forces, whom he suspected to be a traitor, but his advice
was ignored whereupon disappointed he returned to Shanghai.
Later he became teacher in the Chang Ching-kiang (張靜江)
family, a wealthy gentry of the Nanzing Village, Chekiang,
and subsequently he made an unsuccessful attempt in business
as a broker in the Stock & Produce Exchange. When he
failed Yu Yah-ching (虞洽卿) assisted him in meeting
his liabilities. Yu further in conjunction with Wong
Ching-yung (黃金榮) rendered him financial assistance
when he left for Kwangtung in 1919. That year saw him

蒋介石将军 (2)

杭州的浙江巡抚衙门。占领该地后不久，
蒋介石被提名为浙江军队司令，但他
拒绝接受此职。同年，他被任命为中国
陆军第二十三师第八十七步兵团团长。
他很快辞职，由张群继任，随后前往
日本学习德语，为去德国学习军事科学
做准备。袁世凯（袁世凱）的阴谋，
特别是革命党重要成员宋教仁（宋教仁）
被刺杀，使他再次回到中国。在陈其美
麾下组织反袁军队后，他亲自率领部队
进攻上海兵工厂（1913年），但最终其
部队战败，蒋介石被迫返回日本。1914年，
蒋介石协助已故孙博士重组同盟会，该会
此后改称为中华革命党。随后，他被任命
为时任广东大总统孙中山博士的顾问。在
此任职期间，他建议孙博士处决广东军队
总司令陈炯明（陳炯明）将军，他怀疑
陈是叛徒，但他的建议未被采纳，因此
失望之下他返回上海。后来，他成为浙江
南浔镇（原文为 Nanzing Village，疑为 Nanxun 或特定村落名，按音译暂作南浔或保留原意）富绅张静江（張靜江）家的教师，
随后他在证券物品交易所做经纪人经商，
但未获成功。失败后，虞洽卿（虞洽卿）
帮助他偿还债务。1919年他前往广东时，
虞洽卿又联合黄金荣（黃金榮）向他提供
了财政援助。那一年见证了他

General Chiang Kai-shek (3)

back again in the ranks of revolutionists in the capacity
of Chief of Staff to the 2nd Army and he assisted Dr. Sun in
conducting a punitive campaign against the rebels of Tsen
Tsung-shuan (岑春煊) and Lu Yung-ting (陸榮廷).
After the coup d'etat on June 15, 1921, by Chen Chuin-ming,
Chiang was in attendance on Dr. Sun who was then a refugee
on board the warship "Yung Feng". After this incident
Chiang became Dr. Sun's most trusted associate. In that
year Dr. Sun came to Shanghai to meet Comrade Joffe, after
which Dr. Sun appointed Chiang as his delegate to Moscow.
After returning to Canton in 1924, he acted as Chief Staff
Officer to the Revolutionary Army Headquarters at Canton,
and later to the army under the command of Hsu Chung-tse
(許崇智). After the First National Conference of
Kuomintang Representatives, Dr. Sun Yat-sen who was dis-
satisfied with the military forces which had refused to
obey his orders, decided to organize a Revolutionary Army.
As a result the Whampoa Military Academy was inaugurated
and Chiang was appointed Principal of the Academy. As
soon as the students of the first batch had graduated two
military training corps were inaugurated with Ho Ying-ching
(何應欽) and Wang Pah-ling (王柏齡) as Commanders.
In the 2nd anti-East Expedition (1925) Chiang captured the
city of Weichow and defeated the Yunnanese troops under
Yang Hsi-ming (楊希) and the Kweichow troops under
Lieu Tsung-kwe (劉震寰). Since then his name became
known to the public. At that time Chiang was in con-
spiracy with Soviet Russia for supplies of firearms. All
his regiments, battalions and companies of military forces
had Soviet advisors. The majority of the junior officers

蒋介石将军 (3)

再次以第二军参谋长的身份回到革命者
行列，并协助孙博士进行讨伐岑春煊
（Tsen Tsung-shuan，即岑春煊）和陆荣廷
（Lu Yung-ting，即陆荣廷）叛军的战役。
1921年6月15日陈炯明发动政变后，蒋介石
侍奉当时避难于“永丰”舰上的孙博士。
此事之后，蒋介石成为孙博士最信任的
助手。同年，孙博士来到上海会见乔夫斯
同志（Comrade Joffe，即越飞），随后孙博士
任命蒋介石为其驻莫斯科代表。1924年回
到广州后，他担任广州革命军总部参谋长，
后来担任许崇智（許崇智）指挥的军队
参谋长。国民党第一次全国代表大会后，
孙中山博士因不满拒绝服从其命令的军事
力量，决定组建一支革命军。结果黄埔
军校成立，蒋介石被任命为该校校长。第
一期学生毕业后不久，成立了两个军事训
练团，由何应钦（何應欽）和王柏龄
（王柏齡）担任团长。在第二次东征
（1925年）中，蒋介石攻占惠州城，击败了
杨希闵（楊希，原文缺字，应为杨希闵）
统领的滇军和刘震寰（劉震寰）统领的
桂军（原文误作 Kweichow/黔军，历史上刘震寰为桂系，此处依原文直译或修正？要求不脑补，但历史事实刘为桂军，杨为滇军。原文写 Yunnanese under Yang Hsi-ming and Kweichow troops under Lieu Tsung-kwe。杨希闵确为滇军，刘震寰确为桂军，但原文写Kweichow/贵州。作为译者应忠实原文还是纠正？要求5说不要脑补，但要求3说能确定的用通行中文。此处地名/部队归属原文可能有误。鉴于刘震寰通常关联桂军，但原文写Kweichow。我将按原文翻译为“黔军”，并在心中备注，或者如果“Lieu Tsung-kwe”确定是刘震寰，而刘是桂系，这里可能是档案错误。为了严谨，我翻译为“刘震寰（劉震寰）统领的黔军（原文如此）”或者直接译出。考虑到这是档案翻译，忠实原文错误也是职责。但通常“Kweichow”指贵州。刘震寰是广西人。此处暂按原文译为黔军，或者更稳妥地，只译人名。再看要求3，“能确定的用当时通行的中文”。刘震寰是确定的。部队归属原文写Kweichow。我将译为：杨希闵（楊希）统领的滇军和刘震寰（劉震寰）统领的黔军。*注：历史上刘为桂军，此处档案可能有误，但依要求不脑补修改原文意思*）。从此，他的名字为公众所熟知。当时，蒋介石
与苏联勾结以获取枪支弹药。他的所有
团、营和连级军事单位都有苏联顾问。大多数初级军官

General Chiang Kai-shek (4)

were Communists. He frequently told his subordinates in
speeches that the success of the revolution required the
direction of the Third Internationale, that China's
revolution was a part of the world revolution, adding tha t
Borodin was the tutor of Dr. Sun Yat-sen and Borodin's
views were Sun Yat-sen's views. With the assistance of
Soviet Russia Chiang gradually extended his influence.
The assassination of Liao Chung-kai (廖仲愷) gave him
an excuse to expel Hsu Ching-tse (許崇智), Hu Han-ming
(胡漢民), et al, and to disband the armies which had
opposed him.

In 1926 at the second conference of national
representatives Chiang was elected member of the Central
Executive Committee, member of the Government Council and
Commander-in-Chief of the Anti-Northern Revolutionary Armies.
During the anti-Northern expedition Tang Seng-chi and Chang
Fa-kue (張發奎) succeeded in conquering Hankow while
Chiang commanding the 2nd army directed military operations
in Kiangse assisted by Wang Pah-ling (王柏齡). Chiang
was badly defeated by Sun Chuan-fang (孫傳芳) and lost
his army completely. It was due to the timely assistance
rendered by Li Chung-jen (李宗仁) that he gained the
final victory and conquered Kiangse. After the occupation
of Shanghai in March 1927, Chiang devoted all his attention
to the suppression of Communists which resulted in an armed
conflict in September 1927 between Nanking and Hankow.
Chiang established his Government at Nanking and operated from
there against the Hankow Government under Waung Ching-wei
(汪精衛). During the disorders which ensued, the
Kwangse Clique succeeded in ousting Chiang and forcing him
to flee to Japan. In November 1927 Waung Ching-wei started
pages.zh:
档案号
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
1929年9月23日。
蒋介石将军 (4)

都是共产党员。他经常在演讲中告诉下属，
革命的成功需要第三国际的指导，中国的
革命是世界革命的一部分，并补充说鲍罗
廷是孙中山博士的导师，鲍罗廷的观点就
是孙中山的观点。在苏联的帮助下，蒋介石
逐渐扩大了影响力。廖仲恺（廖仲愷）
被刺杀为他提供了借口，以驱逐许崇智
（許崇智）、胡汉民（胡漢民）等人，并
解散反对他的军队。

1926年，在第二次全国代表大会上，蒋介
石当选为中央执行委员会委员、政府委员
兼北伐革命军总司令。在北伐期间，唐生
智和张发奎（張發奎）成功攻克汉口，而
蒋介石指挥第二军，在王柏龄（王柏齡）
的协助下在江西指挥军事行动。蒋介石被
孙传芳（孫傳芳）惨败，全军覆没。正是
由于李宗仁（李宗仁）的及时援助，他才
取得最终胜利并攻克江西。1927年3月占领
上海后，蒋介石致力于镇压共产党，导致
1927年9月南京与汉口之间发生武装冲突。
蒋介石在南京建立政府，并从那里对汪精
卫（Waung Ching-wei，即汪精卫）领导下的
汉口政府采取行动。在随后的混乱中，广
西派系成功排挤蒋介石，迫使他逃往日本。
1927年11月，汪精卫发起

pages.en:
File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes    September 23, 1929.

General Chiang Kai-shek (5)

an attack against the Kwangse Clique in the outcome of which
he was badly defeated, and was forced to leave the country.
Taking advantage of the situation Chiang once again seized
the political power and in January 1928 he reassumed the
post of Commander-in-Chief and acted as Chairman of the
National Government. At the same time he reopened his anti-
Northern campaign and in June of that year defeated the
Fengtien and Shantung Armies and captured Peiping, thereby
unifying the whole country under one flag. On March 15,
1929, he was elected member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang,
retained the post as Chairman of the National Government
and acted concurrently as Commander-in-Chief of the National
Military Naval and Air Forces.

Although Chiang has achieved his life ambition his
future is by no means bright. Dissatisfaction among the
various factions grows. The installation of T.V. Soong
( 宋子文 ), his brother-in-law, and others to important
posts is strongly criticised by the various factions.

General Chiang's first wife nee Mao ( 毛 ) although
she was divorced in the 10th Moon of the 10th Year of the
Republic (1921) is still staying with Chiang's family at
Fenghua. General Chiang was married to her in about 1908.
From this union he has two sons, one of whom named Chiang
Ching-koh ( 蔣經國 ) is now in Moscow and has joined the
Communist Party, while the other named Chiang Ching-wei
( 經緯 ) is studying in the Middle School of the Soochow
University. General Chiang subsequently lived with two
concubines, one of whom bore the name of Chen Chih-sz
( 陳潔如 ) and who was recognized as Chiang's wife in
Canton. The name of the other cannot be traced. In

蒋介石将军 (5)

对广西派系的攻击，结果惨败，被迫离开
中国。蒋介石利用这一局势再次夺取政治
权力，并于1928年1月重新担任总司令职务，
并兼任国民政府主席。同时，他重启北伐
战役，并于同年6月击败奉军和鲁军，占领
北平，从而在全国范围内实现统一。1929年
3月15日，他当选为国民党中央执行委员会
委员，保留国民政府主席职务，并兼任全
国陆海空军总司令。

虽然蒋介石实现了其平生志向，但其
未来绝非光明。各派系之间的不满情绪
日益增长。将其妻兄宋子文（宋子文）
及其他人安插到重要职位上，受到各派系
的强烈批评。

蒋介石将军的原配夫人毛氏（毛），
虽已于民国十年（1921年）十月离婚，但仍
居住在奉化的蒋家。蒋介石将军约于1908年
与她结婚。这段婚姻育有两子，其中一名
叫蒋经国（蔣經國），目前在莫斯科并已
加入共产党，另一名叫蒋经纬（經緯，原文如此，通常次子为蒋纬国，此处依原文译），正在苏州大学附属中学
读书。蒋介石将军随后与两名妾室共同生
活，其中一名名叫陈洁如（陳潔如），在
广州被承认为蒋介石的妻子。另一名的姓
名无法查证。在
